summary: Franklin Solana Trust, a Delaware statutory trust sponsoring Franklin Solana ETF (SOEZ), filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a routine operational change: the sponsor will liquidate monthly staking rewards from the fund's Solana holdings and distribute cash to shareholders, with distributions calculated on a two-month lag. This is an ordinary distribution policy update for an actively managed crypto ETF, not a special situation such as a restructuring, capital return event, or strategic review. There is no premium, tender offer, merger, or board action. Investors should monitor the fund's website for ongoing distribution details; the filing has no special-situation implications.
